page.layout: One page of text in a heading line at the top, under it two columns of index entries: left column (continued from the previous page, opening with a fragment) and right column with letter headings E, F, G. Below the right column a line of pilcrows and the catchword at the right.

main_text.head: Index rerum.
main_text.l: opera nostra vitâ æternâ, cap. 9. § 2, & 3. cap. 10.

page.notes: The left column opens mid-entry with a fragment ("æternam. Multiplex ad-") continued from the previous page, so it is kept as a fragment. Printed running head and page number are absent. The initial letters E, G and F are large woodcut-style capitals joined to their words. Some italic/roman distinctions in the index lines (e.g. "Digni", "Dispositiones.") are uncertain from the scan. The catchword "Gra-" is the start of the next page's first word. The first lines of the right column were read at reduced resolution; "Ethnici Pontificios revin-" and "Probatur ex quinq;" are close readings.
